The presence of a common target, Mcl-1, in multiple pathways reinforces the possibility of a functional link between the drug and the protein. The scores assigned to the relationships indicate a moderate level of confidence in this association, suggesting that further experimental validation would be necessary to confirm the biological relevance of this interaction.
